text: Santo Domingo is a town and municipality located in the Colombian department of Antioquia, situated within the Northeastern Antioquia subregion at an altitude of 1,975 meters (6,480 feet) above sea level. The municipality was established in 1778 by Don Juan Gregorio Duque, and in 1858, the writer Tomás Carrasquilla was born there.
